name: Lake County, FL
findings: Lake County has 1,034 nonprofit organizations. 405 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 320 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lake County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few professional organizations list membership
observations.text: 6 professional organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 16 would.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through professional groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Lake County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 114 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 114 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few education organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 5 education organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 12 would.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
